description: This file contains implementation of functions related to MAPE (Mapping of Address and Port Encapsulation) configuration in a WAN management context. It handles setting up tunnels, calculating PSIDs, and managing syscfg parameters.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanManager_MAPEConfiguration(ipc_map_data_t * dhcp6cMAPEMsgBody,const WANMGR_IPV6_DATA * ipv6Data)
methods.description: Configures MAPE settings, establishes tunnels, and updates syscfg parameters based on provided DHCP MAP-E message data and IPv6 info.

methods.name: INT WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid(CHAR * pdIPv6Prefix,INT v6PrefixLen,INT v4PrefixLen,INT ea_length,USHORT * psidValue,UINT * ipv4IndexValue,UINT * psidLen)
methods.description: Calculates the PSID, IPv4 suffix, and PSID length from the IPv6 prefix and EA length.

methods.name: VOID WanManager_MAPE_ResetSyscfgDefaults(VOID)
methods.description: Unsets the syscfg parameters related to MAPE configuration to reset to defaults.

ctags.name: WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid
ctags.signature: (CHAR * pdIPv6Prefix,INT v6PrefixLen,INT v4PrefixLen,INT ea_length,USHORT * psidValue,UINT * ipv4IndexValue,UINT * psidLen)
